about_the_game:
As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a newly appointed Consul in a secretive global cult. Your mission: unite the fractured nations of the world before an unpredictable endgame calamity strikes. Rather than ruling a single country, you operate from the shadows—managing agents, manipulating diplomacy, and carefully influencing global powers.

The world is on the brink. Tensions rise. Crises loom. And you’re the only one with a plan to bring humanity together… or reshape it entirely.

Gameplay

You begin in the cult’s command room, promoted to the rank of Consul. Your orders come through a flickering monitor running UniteOS, the cult’s proprietary operating system. From there, you send agents across a fractured world, nudging nations toward unity—or submission.

Each country has unique traits and is part of a broader coalition. Some are friendly, others hostile. As you gain control, unrest rises, and managing larger populations becomes harder. Random events, shifting alliances, and emerging threats force you to adapt constantly.

Features

  • Play as a cult, not a country — send agents, rig elections, and influence nations.

  • Every run ends with a unique global crisis — from pandemics to AI uprisings.

  • Manage resources across the world — balance power, unrest, and strategy.

  • Retro-futuristic setting — operate from a 1950s dream of a secret underground HQ.

  • Multiple endings — unite the world, survive the calamity, or bring it all down.

Whether you aim to save humanity or reshape it in your image, the world won’t wait.

Unite, before it's too late.

Wishlist now to get notified when the free demo comes out!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
